description.zh:
指定增量写入模块的位点，格式为Unix时间戳。

> 默认为原任务停止时DTS自动保存的位点。
description.en:
The checkpoint of the incremental write module. The value is a UNIX timestamp.

> Default value: the checkpoint that is automatically saved by DTS when the original task is stopped.
The ID of the task generated by calling the **CreateReverseDtsJob** operation.

description.zh: 资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。
description.en: The resource group ID. This is a global parameter and does not need to be passed in for this operation.

descriptions.zh: 在调用此接口前，您需要在控制台或者调用[DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~)查看反向任务的状态，确保该任务未被释放且是暂停状态。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, check the status of the reverse task in the console or by calling [DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~). Make sure that the task has not been released and is in the paused state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts start-reverse-writer --dts-job-id n99m9jx822k0000 --check-point 1695613785 --resource-group-id '资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。' --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts StartReverseWriter --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId n99m9jx822k0000 --ResourceGroupId '资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。' --CheckPoint 1695613785
